name: 16-restore-a-backup
description: A backup from before config files were state documents, restored through the File Manager's Restore

steps.caption: A backup carries every setting, and Restore puts them back, on this device or another.
Restore asks twice, so a click cannot overwrite anything by accident. This backup was made in September, before the config files changed shape.
The report lists what was renamed on the way, and anything that did not carry over.
Close the report, and look at the cards.
Every setting is back: the Lines effect the backup holds, at its speed.
And the brightness it was saved at.
